doc_title: Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership of Fenlight Carrow Ventures II, L.P.
notes: Early-stage venture LPA whose economics are tiered rather than flat: the management fee is 2.50% of commitments for Fee Years 1 to 5, then falls 0.25% a year to a 1.50% floor, and carry steps up from 20% to 25% only after Limited Partners receive 3.0x paid-in capital, so single-number answers are incomplete. Seven fields are absences, each stated expressly (no preferred return, no high-water mark, no redemption, lock-up, notice or gate, no prime broker). The document scatters look-alike numbers a model may misfile: 7% equalization interest, a 3.0x step-up threshold, 10 Business Day capital calls, a 15-day GP-required withdrawal notice, about $1,250,000 of Affiliated Limited Partner commitments that do not count toward the GP Commitment, and a named Principal (Imogen Ravell) who is expressly not a Key Person.

traps.management_fee: The 2.50% rate on commitments applies only to Fee Years 1 to 5; from Fee Year 6 it drops 0.25% a year (2.25%, 2.00%, 1.75%) to a 1.50% floor that runs through any extension, still on commitments, so a bare 2.50% answer is incomplete.
traps.performance_fee: Carry is tiered: 20% until distributions to Limited Partners reach 3.0x their paid-in capital, then 25% prospectively with no catch-up, so a flat 20% answer misses the step-up.
traps.hurdle_rate: Section 6.3 expressly denies any preferred return or hurdle; neither the 7% equalization interest in Section 3.3(c) nor the 3.0x step-up threshold in Section 6.4 is a hurdle, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.high_water_mark: Section 6.6(b) states that no high-water mark or loss carryforward is maintained because carry is whole-fund with a clawback, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.lockup_period: Section 9.2 grants no redemption right and disclaims any lock-up period; the 10-year term and 5-year investment period must not be reported as a lock-up.
traps.redemption_frequency: Limited Partners cannot redeem at any time (Section 9.2); the GP-initiated required withdrawal in Section 9.3 confers no redemption right.
traps.redemption_notice_days: The only notice periods in the document are for capital calls (10 Business Days), term extensions (90 days), MFN elections (30 days) and GP-required withdrawals (15 days); none is a redemption notice, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.gate_provision: With no redemption right there is no gate; the 15%, 20% and 25% concentration, borrowing and recall limits are not gates.
traps.gp_commitment: Section 3.2 sets the GP Commitment at not less than 2.0% of aggregate Capital Commitments and separately discloses Affiliated Limited Partner commitments expected to total about $1,250,000, which are made individually and expressly do not count toward the GP Commitment, so the answer is the 2.0% requirement, not the $1,250,000 figure.
traps.prime_broker: Section 8.4 states the Partnership does not engage a prime broker; the bank or broker-dealer holding cash and listed securities is not one.

fund_structure.expected: Closed-end drawdown fund: capital is called from Unfunded Commitments and Interests are not redeemable; a stand-alone Delaware partnership, not a master-feeder (Alternative Investment Vehicles permitted for legal, tax or regulatory reasons)
fund_structure.quote: The Partnership is a closed-end investment vehicle.

management_fee.expected: 2.50% per annum of aggregate Capital Commitments (excluding Affiliated Limited Partners and the GP Commitment) for Fee Years 1 through 5; from Fee Year 6 the rate steps down by 0.25% each Fee Year (2.25% in Fee Year 6, 2.00% in Fee Year 7, 1.75% in Fee Year 8) to a floor of 1.50% of Capital Commitments from Fee Year 9 onward, including any extension; payable semi-annually in advance and reduced by 100% of Fee Income, placement fees and excess Organizational Expenses
management_fee.quote: Accordingly, the annual rate is 2.25% for Fee Year 6, 2.00% for Fee Year 7, 1.75% for Fee Year 8, and the Floor Rate of 1.50% for Fee Year 9 and each Fee Year thereafter.

hurdle_rate.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE: the LPA expressly provides no preferred return or hurdle rate (Section 6.3); carried interest begins once a Limited Partner's Capital Contributions are returned, with no catch-up
hurdle_rate.quote: The Limited Partners are not entitled to any preferred return, hurdle rate or other priority return on their Capital Contributions.

high_water_mark.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE: the LPA states the Partnership does not maintain a high-water mark or loss carryforward account (Section 6.6(b)); carried interest is computed on a cumulative whole-fund basis subject to a GP clawback
high_water_mark.quote: the Partnership does not maintain a high-water mark, loss carryforward account or similar mechanism

minimum_initial_investment.expected: $1,000,000 minimum Capital Commitment per Limited Partner (the General Partner may accept lesser amounts; the minimum does not apply to Affiliated Limited Partners)
minimum_initial_investment.quote: The minimum Capital Commitment of each Limited Partner, other than an Affiliated Limited Partner, is $1,000,000

lockup_period.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE: Limited Partners have no right to withdraw or redeem (Section 9.2) and the LPA provides for no lock-up period; Interests are subject only to transfer restrictions

redemption_frequency.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE: closed-end; no Limited Partner may withdraw or redeem any part of its Interest at any time (Section 9.2)
redemption_frequency.quote: No Limited Partner has the right to withdraw from the Partnership, or to redeem, withdraw or require the Partnership to repurchase all or any part of its Interest

gate_provision.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE: Interests are not redeemable and the LPA provides no limitation on redemptions (Section 9.2), so no gate exists

key_man_provision.expected: Key Persons: Delphine Wrexcombe and Tobias Quennell. A Key Person Event occurs if either dies or becomes permanently incapacitated, ceases to devote substantially all business time to the Partnership and the Affiliated Funds, or ceases to be a managing member of the General Partner; it automatically suspends the Investment Period (only previously committed investments and follow-ons up to 10% of commitments), and unless a Majority in Interest approves continuation within 180 days the Investment Period terminates permanently. Imogen Ravell is a Principal but not a Key Person
key_man_provision.quote: The "Key Persons" are Delphine Wrexcombe and Tobias Quennell

gp_commitment.expected: Not less than 2.0% of the aggregate Capital Commitments of all Partners (including the General Partner's own), funded in cash pro rata and not through a management fee waiver; Affiliated Limited Partner commitments (about $1,250,000 expected) do not count toward it
gp_commitment.quote: equal to not less than two percent (2.0%) of the aggregate Capital Commitments of all Partners, including the Capital Commitment of the General Partner
